After the beacon purification, the Builders thought they could go home.
But though the Wither had been beaten, the Undead Rot remained.
And the Warlocks began raiding the villages;
the Scourge villagers' fury left the Overworld wilder than the Wither had left it.
So the Builders chose to hide underground once more —
There they dug out a vast underground complex, around Y -50 —
The stronghold had many levels and many rooms,
libraries, treasure vaults, halls of altars.
It was never built to be lived in,
but so the Builders could go on living beneath the earth.
